beamlord.title: Beamlord
beamlord.notes: Balthazar gone mad with his lightning: a 14 m beam, a sweeping spread and a nova ring round him, twice as fast, chaining while A or B is held; in the air he fires a bolt straight down from his hands until he lands, and there a blue dome rises out of the floor round him, its blast throwing enemies back; translucent electric-blue bolts along the beam, branching and flickering, that hit through walls (D332, D385, D442); on the nova the game's electric shield rises round him, a translucent electric-blue force field 1.44 m round his chest, from his feet to over his head, that crackles and turns to face you, fading in as the nova's ring grows and out after it (D433, D442, D479). The airship boss keeps his own look: the beams and the dome are the player's own copy of his effects (D446).

booblord.title: Booblord
booblord.notes: A blue-skinned townswoman with a high black ponytail. She carries Garret's Axion staff and uses his moves, with her own voice, idle poses and victory. Pick the Booblord spin weapon for her own spinning attacks: hold attack to chain them, B for a wider sweep. Her hair and body sway as she moves.

booblord_high.title: Booblord High
booblord_high.notes: Booblord with sharper textures and a thicker sash. Same moves and sounds. Made for xemu set to 128 MiB.

booblord_human.title: Booblord Human
booblord_human.notes: Booblord with light tan skin, brown eyes and an indigo top and sash. Same body, moves and sounds.

booblord_high_human.title: Booblord High Human
booblord_high_human.notes: Booblord High with light tan skin, brown eyes and an indigo top and sash. Same moves and sounds. Made for xemu set to 128 MiB.
